title: LVMH sales edge higher boosted by Sephora and jewelry, despite fashion slide
summary: LVMH, the world's leading luxury group, said on Monday, October 13, its sales edged higher in the third quarter despite a slowdown in China hitting its fashion and leather goods segment. The group, whose brands include Louis Vuitton, Dior, Celine and drinks maker Hennessy, took in 18.5 billion euros (US$20.6 billion) in the three months to the end of September, beating the consensus of analysts polled by Factset financial data firm.
